gloss: to trim evenly; to cut to a uniform length

definitions.gloss: to trim evenly; to cut to a uniform length
definitions.explanation: To cut multiple things so they are all the same length or shape. Used for hair, hedges, nails, paper, and similar items.

examples.japanese: {髪|かみ}を{切|き}り{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: I had my hair trimmed evenly.

examples.japanese: {生垣|いけがき}をきれいに{切|き}り{揃|そろ}えた。
{爪|つめ}を{切|き}り{揃|そろ}えてから{面接|めんせつ}に{向|む}かった。
examples.english: I trimmed my nails neatly before heading to the interview.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb combining {切|き}る (to cut) and {揃|そろ}える (to arrange uniformly). Emphasizes making things even and uniform, not just cutting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {髪|かみ}を{切|き}り{揃|そろ}える (to trim hair evenly)
- {前髪|まえがみ}を{切|き}り{揃|そろ}える (to trim bangs evenly)
- {生垣|いけがき}を{切|き}り{揃|そろ}える (to trim a hedge)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {切|き}る: to cut — general cutting without the nuance of uniformity
- {整|ととの}える: to arrange, to put in order — broader, not specific to cutting
